projection: equirectangular, north up, east to the right; rolled onto the previous site map, lon -0.088 at the centre
normal: tangent space x=east y=north z=up, IMAGE-DERIVED (no global DEM): band-pass luminance (6 px at 8k) as height, bright = high, RMS slope 8 deg where the mosaic is sharp (x Q), x 0.7 in filled areas
colour: previous site map (Lanczos to the top tier) at every scale, its own colours; mission detail L / G8(L) added with weight 0.8 Q where locally registered (phase correlation, residual <= 1.5 px @2k; 98 % of the data area)
source: USGS Astrogeology: Callisto Voyager / Galileo SSI Global Mosaic 1 km
